_comment: THE MODULE 2 OUTPUT CONTRACT. Every lesion detector writes this struct and nothing else; Module 3 reads only this. Agree it BEFORE parallel work starts - it is what lets five detectors be built independently and still integrate. Adding a field is safe; renaming or removing one breaks Phase 3 and must be a deliberate versioned change.
_owner: R1 (Abhigyan) - contract owner; detector authors implement against it

_units_policy.rule: EVERY spatial quantity is expressed in DISC DIAMETERS (DD), never pixels.
_units_policy.why: Our corpora span a 6.7x resolution range (640x480 to 4288x2848). A count-per-pixel or an area-in-pixels feature silently encodes camera model rather than pathology, and Phase 3 would learn the dataset instead of the disease. Module 1 hit this exact failure with the sharpness metric (r = -0.75 against FOV diameter) - do not repeat it here.
_units_policy.conversion: dd = pixels / (2 * discRadiusPx), where discRadiusPx comes from locateOpticDisc. Areas divide by (2*discRadiusPx)^2.
_units_policy.fallback: If the disc is not found, set anatomy.discFound = false and fall back to fovDiameter/6.48 - the measured IDRiD disc/FOV ratio. Flag it; Phase 3 may choose to drop those cases.

anatomy.discConfidence: 0..1 - measured to track error at Spearman rho -0.70, so it is usable for weighting
anatomy.laterality: 'OD' | 'OS' | 'unknown' - which eye. Derived from whether the disc is temporal or nasal to the fovea. Needed because lesion position relative to the macula is side-dependent.

microaneurysms.countWithin1DD: integer within 1 disc diameter of the fovea centre
microaneurysms.densityPerDD2: double, count per square disc diameter
microaneurysms._note: Best published IDRiD AUPR for MA is 0.5017. Expect a noisy feature and report it as such; a Phase 2 MA score near 0.9 means a bug or a leak.

haemorrhages.areaDD2: double, total area in square disc diameters
haemorrhages.countByType: struct with fields dot, blot, flame - integers
haemorrhages._note: Dot haemorrhages and MAs are the same size; separation is by colour and edge sharpness, not size alone. Whatever rule is used, write it in the detector's help text.

hardExudates.minDistanceToFoveaDD: double - DRIVES THE DME ENDPOINT. IDRiD grades DME risk by shortest distance from the macula centre to any hard exudate: grade 2 = within 1 DD. See config/clinical_definitions.json.

softExudates._note: IDRiD has soft-exudate masks for only 26 of 54 training images. This will be the least reliable channel; Module 4 should weight its evidence accordingly.

neovascularization._note: Heuristic detector, marker of proliferative DR (ICDR grade 4). Low prevalence - 49 of 413 IDRiD training images are grade 4 - so expect very few positives and do not tune it to fire more often.

vessels._note: Vessel map is also consumed by locateOpticDisc's vesselWeight option, which is currently 0 because the black-top-hat proxy was too crude. Wiring the real segmentation there is a one-line change.

quality._comment: Carried through from Module 1 so Phase 3 can weight or exclude marginal images, and so Phase 6 can report the referral_or_recapture endpoint.

_provenance.pipelineVersion: string - git describe at extraction time
_provenance._why: Phase 6 compares an integrated pipeline against a baseline. Without provenance on every feature row, a result cannot be traced back to the code that produced it.
